newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Somague, A Silva deal next week.
newsitem.headline: Somague, A Silva deal next week.

text.p: Portuguese civil engineering firm Somague expects to announce the terms of an agreement with building company A.Silva & Silva next week, Somague president Diogo Vaz Guedes said.
The agreement should not penalise shareholders, he said.
"I can guarantee that shareholders will not be penalised because we are trying to improve things for shareholders," Diogo Vaz Guedes told Reuters.
"After the beginning of next week the details of the agreement will be known," he said.
The two firms said on Wednesday that they had held talks about a possible exchange of shares.
One option would be for Somague, which has specialised in public works projects, to acquire some or all of the construction interests of A.Silva & Silva, a statement said.
Analysts said Somague wanted to buy A.Silva & Silva's building subsidiary Assiconstroi, which is active in private and public sector residential, commercial and industrial building.
They said the deal for at least 10 billion escudos ($60 million) would make Somague Portugal's biggest construction group, surpassing Soares da Costa.
Somague shares recovered slightly on the Lisbon bourse after dropping nearly 10 percent on Thursday and stood at 1,900, up 10, in volume of 59,400 shares in afternoon trade.
A.Silva & Silva shares were trading at 1,710 escudos, down five, in light volume of 4,600 shares.
